body:
Not sure users on Android can press F5 or anything like this :)
Same in other places.
Will be great to make "Project Settings (Display > Display Server > Driver)." clickable link, opening this setting (I suppose it will require converting `Label` to `RichTextLabel`).
Same as with project setting above.

Technically, that feedback could apply to any tooltip/text that shows a shortcut when there's no physical keyboard connected. However, we don't have a way in Godot to query whether a keyboard is connected (not even on the Android platform, where it's most likely that you *may* or may not have a keyboard connected).

I would prefer we keep the shortcut indication on Android for now, as we still recommend having a physical keyboard connected for the best experience.

Oh, btw I'm wrong, Android does not have this screen at all. Sorry for misinformation.
In this case, maybe we could add buttons here for running project?
